source_text: Ex adventu Christi gentes convertuntur ad Deum. Magnifica erant quae tunc observabantur, sed umbra caelestium.
pass_a_gloss: From advent of-Christ nations are-converted to God. Magnificent were which then were-observed, but shadow of-heavenly.
pass_b_english: By Christ’s coming the nations turn to God. What was then observed was magnificent, yet [[a shadow of the heavenly >> Bible:Hebrews 8:5]].
